text:
jonathan: Hey team — new pilot tenant needs GPUs in af-south-2 (Africa South 2). Can we raise p5 / g5 / p4d instance quotas and pre-warm ENI/NAT capacity for account 987654321000? Start date is tight: Pilot starts next Monday, need burst of ~8 p5 nodes + 12 g5 for 2 weeks.

maya: Copy — thanks. Can you paste the account org-id and the VPC/subnet CIDR we should reserve? Also do we want on-demand burst or spot-backed pool?

jonathan: Org ID: org-ff12ab34. VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e. Subnets: 10.10.32.0/20 (eu-facing), 10.10.48.0/20 (egress). Prefer on-demand for first 48h fallback then spot for remainder.

raj: Quick notes: af-south-2 has limited p5 stock; AWS may only allow soft quota increases. Recommend request: p5 -> 12, g5 -> 16, p4d -> 4, ENI ceiling bump to 500, Elastic IP pool request 50, NATGW throughput plan. Include justification: production pilot for enterprise customer with SLA.

sean: Heads up on cost — 2-week burst at those counts ~ estimate $70k (on-demand) before discounts. If we convert some to spot after 48h we can shave ~35%. Confirm billing owner so Finance can approve.

jonathan: Finance contact is amanda@redwood.com. I'll open a billing approval ticket. Also attaching the pilot runbook: https://redwood.internal/pilot-runbooks/af-south2-pilot (internal).

maya: I created the quota template — please run the support case using this body. Patch below: 

```
Service: Amazon EC2
Region: af-south-2
Requested increases:
 - p5 instances: current 0 -> desired 12
 - g5 instances: current 0 -> desired 16
 - p4d instances: current 0 -> desired 4
 - Attached ENI limit: current 50 -> desired 500
 - Elastic IPs: current 5 -> desired 50
Justification: Pilot for enterprise customer, expected sustained usage and latency SLOs; we need burst for 2-week evaluation starting 2024-05-05. Contact: jonathan@redwood.com, billing: amanda@redwood.com
```

raj: Add fallback routing policy: if af-south-2 can't satisfy p5, auto-failover to eu-west-3 with capacity tag `pilot-af-fallback`. Also request allowlist for our AMIs to speed provisioning.

infra-bot: quota-case-created: #CASE-2026-8942 — created by maya. Support link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=CASE-2026-8942

jonathan: Perfect. Can someone follow up with AWS AMER quota team (cc @maya) and ping partner account rep? I'll post the pilot manifest once I have the confirmed numbers. :thumbsup:

maya: On it. I scheduled a call with the AWS quota team for 2024-04-29 14:00 UTC and added the support case number to the calendar invite.

sean: Finance approved provisional spend up to $80k for the pilot with commit to retro discounts if we convert to reserved for production. I'll email Amanda to confirm.

jonathan: Thanks all — I'll close the loop when AWS confirms. Leaving this thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
